title: Design System: Ayoub Lahmany Barber Shop

display.purpose: Outlined double-stroke block caps for billed acts and section-scale titles. Fill transparent, 0.022em ink stroke; ::before 0.105em ink stroke with bleed filter; ::after 0.06em card stroke. wdth 112 on mobile.

headline.purpose: Section headings set as black slugs with card text.

title.purpose: Cut names, lineup title, drop-zone title, logo name (wdth 108 to 112).

numeral.purpose: Prices and face readings, tabular figures. Rank numerals use wdth 125 with a 2px ink stroke.

condensed.purpose: Buttons, nav, filters, strapline, address, dock. Always uppercase.

body.purpose: Intros, cut reasons, privacy text; weight 600 to 700; measure 34ch to 60ch; 16px on mobile.

label.purpose: Table heads, reading terms, tags, captions, legends. Uppercase, tracked 0.1 to 0.12em.

rules.name: rule
rules.purpose: Outer structure: buttons, plates, tables, filters, section rules.

rules.name: rule-thin
rules.purpose: Internal division: table cells, tags, lineup rows, readings.

textures.name: screen-grain
textures.value: body::after fixed fractalNoise SVG (baseFrequency .9, 3 octaves), opacity 0.42, mix-blend-mode multiply, z-index 100
textures.purpose: Paper grain over the whole poster.

textures.name: pink-dot-screen
textures.value: background-image: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(10,10,10,0.17) 0.9px, transparent 1.3px); background-size: 5px 5px
textures.purpose: Applied over every flat pink fill so it reads as printed ink.

textures.name: bleed
textures.value: SVG filter #bleed: feTurbulence fractalNoise 0.9, 2 octaves, seed 7; feDisplacementMap scale 1.6
textures.purpose: Ink spread on solid slugs and the heavy stroke of outlined display type.

textures.name: halftone-ramp
textures.value: Staggered dot grid; radius shrinks linearly to zero across the fade band
textures.purpose: Shading language for fades in pictograms, the drop-zone head, and the printed photo.

shadows.name: second-outline
shadows.purpose: Hover on buttons and nav booking; resting state of active filter or chip. The only sanctioned box-shadow.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 3px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: 4px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 7px var(--pink)

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Default for state transitions, slam, FLIP, caliper draw.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Hover, press (scale 0.97 buttons, 0.96 chips), underline draw.

motion.name: slam
motion.purpose: Billed acts landing in register on load.

motion.name: wipe
motion.purpose: Tape band and boxheads printing on.

motion.name: misregister
motion.value: 700ms, pink halftone pass offset decays to 0.25 cell (ease-out quart)
motion.purpose: Photo print: pink pass slams into register.

motion.name: flip-rerank
motion.value: 520ms translateY FLIP; new rows 360ms fade from blur, stagger 30ms
motion.purpose: Lineup re-ranking after face analysis or filter change.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables slam, wipe, FLIP, pulses, smooth scroll

narrative.northStar: The Dance Bill on Fluorescent Card
narrative.overview:
The whole surface is one screen-printed poster. Fluorescent yellow card is the paper, black is the ink, hot pink is the second pass through the screen. Services and haircuts are billed like the acts at a dance night: outlined block caps, prices in black slugs, a pink tape band struck across at an angle. The world is loud, flat, and hand-made. Grain lies over everything, solid ink boxes bleed slightly at the edges, and every tone is a halftone screen rather than a smooth blend.

Density is poster density. Very large outlined display lines take the full width, and condensed caps carry everything practical: labels, nav, buttons, table heads. Structure comes from hand-ruled black lines and ruled grids, never from cards that float. Interaction is printing: a photo is screened onto the card as halftone, ink calipers measure it, the bill re-ranks, and active choices pick up a second outline.

It is neither the black-and-gold barber-pole template nor white spa minimalism. Both are confirmed rejections in the direction contract and the build holds to them.
keyCharacteristics: Three inks on fluorescent card: yellow ground, black ink, pink second stock.
One variable family, Archivo, pushed across its width axis: expanded 125% for acts, condensed 68% for labels.
Square corners everywhere; 3px ink rules for structure, 2px for internal division.
Halftone dots as the only shading language, including the pink fills.
Paper physics: fixed screen grain (multiply, 0.42) and a displacement "bleed" on solid ink.
Motion is a print run: acts slam into register, tape and headings wipe on, the pink pass lands misregistered and settles.

rules.name: The Three Inks Rule
rules.body: A screen is card, ink, and pink. Screen Pink appears only as a state. No fourth hue, no greys: lighter values are made by a dot screen, never by a new color.

rules.name: The Printed Pink Rule
rules.body: Any flat pink fill carries the halftone screen (radial-gradient dots, 0.9px, rgba(10,10,10,0.17), on a 5px grid). Flat, unscreened pink is a screen color, not ink.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from width and stroke as much as from size: expanded (125) is for billed acts, condensed (68) is for anything a visitor operates or scans. Don't introduce a second family.

rules.name: The Outlined Act Rule
rules.body: Outlined double-stroke caps are only for billed lines and section-scale titles, at display size. Never outline body-scale text.

rules.name: The Second Outline Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is drawn as another ruled outline around the object, never as an offset or blurred shadow.

rules.name: The Clean Proof Rule
rules.body: The try-on result is judged without grain: the plate lifts above the grain layer (z-index 101) only while it holds a generated image.

dos: Do build every surface from card, ink, and pink only, with Screen Pink reserved for hover and press.
Do screen every pink fill with the 5px halftone dot pattern.
Do draw tone and fades as halftone ramps (dot radius shrinking), in pictograms, plates, and illustrations alike.
Do divide space with 3px ink rules and ruled grids; use 2px inside tables and lists.
Do set every operable control and label in condensed (wdth 68) heavy caps.
Do mark hover and active with the second outline (3px card, then 3px ink).
Do apply the bleed filter to solid ink slugs and the heavy stroke of outlined display type.
Do keep motion physical and brief: slam (620ms), wipe (480 to 520ms), FLIP (520ms), all on cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1) or (0.77, 0, 0.175, 1), and respect reduced motion.
donts: Don't use offset, blurred, or ambient shadows; the second outline is the only box-shadow.
Don't use smooth color gradients for shading; a gradient is only allowed as the generator of a dot screen.
Don't introduce black-and-gold barber-pole styling or white spa minimalism.
Don't add a second typeface or fall back to a system display face.
Don't put small tracked labels or eyebrows above headings; a section heading is the black slug itself.
Don't use icon fonts or text glyphs as icons; icons are inline SVG with square-capped 2.4 to 3.2 strokes.
